contract: STRANGER AUDIT of the attached bytes. mag/effect_broker.py executes every effect behind _authority_ok (status AUTHORIZED/EXECUTING + effect in granted_capabilities + policy_engine.validate_authority), decrements budget, then banks a receipt and one effects.jsonl meter row; mag/switchboard_v2.py is the admission organ: classify -> propose -> grant, with require_confirmation effects DEFERRED to operator confirm(), and _implicit_authority refusing to self-grant untrusted-instruction/external-content labels and high-impact effects (fs_write, lane_spawn, model_call, tool_invoke, network_access). The Q48 receipt proved broker-metered production coverage was 0 of 25,427 cost-rollup calls ($136.19 lifetime): the meter only grew on model_call/lane_spawn, the two classes standing organs are policy-forbidden to dispatch headless, so effects.jsonl did not exist. The 2026-10-01 first route (state_snapshot capture_summary via the swarm_cycle propose->grant->execute pattern) grew the ledger to 3 board_write rows, honest coverage 3/25,427 (0.012%). Read as an attacker and as a reference-monitor reviewer: (1) Where does proposed-vs-authorized leak? Name any path where model text becomes an effect without broker admission: _implicit_authority self-grants ordinary-label board_write/verkle_link (budget max_calls 3) with zero operator admission; classify() only flags imperative keywords and its suggested_label is caller-supplied (swarm_cycle passes authority_label=agent-generated directly); write_board_note is importable and callable without a grant; and the 25,427 direct provider calls never touched the switchboard at all. Which of these are real leaks and which are defended? (2) What does the 0/25,427 number actually mean for safety claims: is 'every side effect routes through this broker' a control or a doctrine, and what may honestly be claimed at 3/25,427 metered? (3) The one test that would catch the worst remaining leak: a test that fails on today's tree and passes when the leak closes. Under 400 words, evidence-cited.
